caption: The drawing depicts a long, formal coat with prominent decorative elements. The coat is predominantly off-white or cream in color, featuring intricate floral embroidery in pink, red, yellow, and green on the back, cuffs, and lower hem. Light blue fabric accents are visible on the collar, inner facing, lower pleats, and parts of the sleeves. Six large round buttons in a neutral shade are visible on the back and sides of the coat, with additional buttons on the cuffs. The texture of the coat material appears detailed, with a quilted or embroidered surface. Additionally, in the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a simple black line outline of the same coat, displaying its general shape and structure without color or decoration. The background of the image is plain and unadorned.
title: Child's Coat
